author: Ari Koslow
title: Max Shulga has team option declined by Celtics
desc: The Celtics declined the team option of Max Shulga.
impact: Shulga will become an unrestricted free agent. He will remain off the fantasy radar.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Amari Williams has team option declined by Celtics
desc: The Celtics declined the team option of Amari Williams.
impact: Williams will become an unrestricted free agent. He will remain off the fantasy radar.

author: Diego Sandoval
title: Jusuf Nurkic intends to sign 2-year deal with Utah Jazz
desc: Jusuf Nurkic intends to sign a 2-year, $22 million deal to return to the Utah Jazz.
impact: Nurkic dealt with some injuries and played in just 41 games last season, but had a successful first year in Utah. The big man averaged 10.9 points, 10.4 rebounds and 4.8 assists per game. The Jazz's frontcourt depth could still see some shakeup this offseason, as Walker Kessler is the subject of many trade rumors.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jordan Walsh has team option picked up by Celtics
desc: The Celtics picked up the team option of Jordan Walsh.
impact: Walsh will remain off the fantasy radar.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Dalano Banton has team option picked up by Celtics
desc: The Celtics picked up the team option of Dalano Banton.
impact: Banton will remain off the fantasy radar.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Neemias Queta has team option picked up by Celtics
desc: The Celtics picked up the team option of Neemias Queta.
impact: Queta will return to Boston for another season. He should remain in a primary role at center for the Celtics.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Brook Lopez has team option picked up by Clippers
desc: The Clippers are picking up the $9.2M team option on Brook Lopez for the 2026-27 season.
impact: Lopez returns to the Clippers for another season. He should remain in a significant role down low at center.

author: Diego Sandoval
title: Julian Champagnie intends to sign 3-year deal with Spurs
desc: Julian Champagnie intends to sign a 3-year, $45 million contract to return to the San Antonio Spurs.
impact: The Spurs declined Champagnie's team option earlier this summer and have now rewarded him with a new contract. The 24-year-old was vital to the team's run to the NBA Finals, averaging 11.2 points and 5.7 rebounds while shooting 39.6% from three-point land in the postseason. He will now be a key piece of the team's young corps in the coming years.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jonathan Kuminga has team option declined by Hawks
desc: The Hawks are declining Jonathan Kuminga's $24.3 million team option.
impact: Kuminga will enter unrestricted free agency. He should have plenty of suitors.

author: Diego Sandoval
title: Kenrich Williams has team option declined by Thunder
desc: The Oklahoma City Thunder are declining Kenrich Williams' $7.2 million team option.
impact: Williams is now an unrestricted free agent after the Thunder opted to let go of his team option. The 31-year-old averaged 6.5 points and 3.3 rebounds per game in the regular season, but did not get much run in the postseason for the Thunder.

author: Diego Sandoval
title: Landry Shamet intends to sign 4-year deal with Knicks
desc: Landry Shamet intends to sign a 4-year, $24 million contract to return to the New York Knicks.
impact: Shamet is coming off a solid postseason run where he shot 47.5% from three-point land and provided some much-needed scoring bursts off the bench. The 29-year-old also averaged 9.3 points per game in the regular season and should be a strong bench option for the Knicks for the near future.

author: Diego Sandoval
title: Kris Murray traded to Memphis Grizzlies
desc: Kris Murray is being traded to the Memphis Grizzlies along with Jerami Grant in exchange for Ja Morant.
impact: Murray will now head to a rebuilding Memphis squad where he could grow into a larger role than he has had with the Blazers. The 25-year-old averaged 5.8 points and 3.6 rebounds while playing 23.4 minutes a game during the 2025-26 season in Portland.

author: Diego Sandoval
title: Jerami Grant traded to Memphis Grizzlies
desc: Jerami Grant is being traded to the Memphis Grizzlies alongside Kris Murray in exchange for Ja Morant.
impact: Grant will head to Memphis as the main contract piece to complete the Morant trade. The veteran is coming off a solid season in Portland, in which he averaged 18.6 points per game while shooting 38.9% from beyond the arc.

author: Diego Sandoval
title: Ja Morant traded to Portland Trail Blazers
desc: Ja Morant is being traded to the Portland Trail Blazers in exchange for Jerami Grant and Kris Murray.
impact: A full season and offseason of trade speculation about Morant has now come to an end, as he is heading to Portland. The 26-year-old is coming off a season in which he averaged 19.5 points and 8.1 assists but played just 20 games. He joins a team with a strong scorer in Deni Avdija, a young big man in Donovan Clingan and Damian Lillard fresh off an injury.

author: Ari Koslow
title: De'Anthony Melton declines player option
desc: De'Anthony Melton is declining his $3.5 million player option with the Warriors.
impact: Melton will test the open market as an unrestricted free agent. He should draw interest.
